title: Primary Series Ashtanga with Sri K. Pattabhi Jois
summary: A 1993 Yoga Works video of the Ashtanga Yoga Primary Series led by Sri K. Pattabhi Jois, with senior students demonstrating. The class is filmed in classic style from the back of the room.
why: HN commenters suggest it as a free guided stretching routine, with the first half hour enough for a good stretch.

quote.text: Try the Ashtanga Yoga Primary series [0] - you don't have to do the whole thing, just the first 30-35 mins gives a good stretch.
